topic: Safety precautions observed while arming, rearming and de-arming.
syllabus_extract: Safety precautions observed while arming, rearming and de-arming.
specific_objectives: 23.1.1.1 Trainee will be able the basic knowledge of air craft armaments.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of safe arming, rearming, and de-arming procedures with instructor supervision.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of arming aircraft armaments?
List three general safety rules for handling weapons.
Why is the de-arming procedure critical before maintenance?

development.content:
Personal protective equipment requirements
Weapon handling and storage protocols
Communication signals during arming
Inspection of safety mechanisms
Emergency response procedures

Step-by-step arming sequence
Rearming verification checks
De-arming isolation techniques
Locking mechanisms operation
Clearance of live ammunition

Common errors in armament handling
Reporting unsafe conditions
Post-operation safety checks
Documentation of armament status
Final clearance procedures

summary_questions: Explain the difference between arming and rearming procedures.
Describe the immediate action required if a safety lock fails during de-arming.
Why must the armament bay be cleared before maintenance begins?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the key safety precautions for arming, rearming, and de-arming to be discussed in the next lesson on guided missiles.

pft_rows.syllabus: Introduction to guided missiles and definition. Classifications of guided missiles –SAM, AAM, SSM & ASM.
